# ThunderStudy News: recent stories (full text index)

## RBI to auction 91-day, 182-day and 364-day Treasury Bills on Nov 18
URL: https://news.thunderstudy.online/study/rbi-to-auction-91-day-182-day-and-364-day-treasury-bills-on-nov-18/
Published: 2026-11-15T04:15:53.059Z
Topic: Banking
Quick answer: The Reserve Bank of India has announced an auction of three Government of India Treasury Bills on November 18, 2026, totalling ₹23,000 crore. The 91-day and 182-day bills are notified at ₹8,000 crore each, and the 364-day bill at ₹7,000 crore. Settlement is on November 19, 2026.
Key points:
- The 91-day and 182-day bills are notified at ₹8,000 crore each.
- The 364-day bill is notified at ₹7,000 crore, taking the total to ₹23,000 crore.
- Bids will be submitted electronically on the RBI's E-Kuber system on November 18.
- Retail investors can bid non-competitively, capped at 5 percent of the notified amount.
- Successful bidders must pay on November 19, 2026.
Original source: RBI - https://www.rbi.org.in/scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=63975

## Anthropic's high valuation may not protect its edge
URL: https://news.thunderstudy.online/news/anthropics-high-valuation-may-not-protect-its-edge/
Published: 2026-11-15T01:36:10.628Z
Topic: Technology
Quick answer: A report in The Hindu questions whether Anthropic's valuation protects its business. It says the company's engineers must keep building progressively more capable models, and that Anthropic has not shown it can stay profitable once it meets its infrastructure commitments. The piece treats valuation as no guarantee of a durable…
Key points:
- The Hindu says Anthropic's valuation does not by itself secure a lasting edge.
- Engineers must keep building progressively more capable AI models, the report notes.
- Anthropic has not shown it can stay profitable after infrastructure commitments.
- The piece ties the firm's position to model progress and cost control.
Original source: The Hindu - https://www.thehindu.com/business/Industry/anthropics-valuation-cant-secure-its-moat/article71702866.ece
